content: Deterministic LLM testing: (1) Stub Model pattern — deterministic non-AI replacement for real LLM, injected into the agent harness, returns fixed JSON matching the tool schema, enables thousands of edge-case tests at zero cost in CI. (2) Golden dataset — curated input/output pairs validated by experts, used as calibration standard for automated evaluation. (3) Layered testing: deterministic layer (everything before model call: data, prompt assembly, schema validation, business logic) can be fully unit tested; stochastic layer (LLM output) requires evaluation metrics and multiple runs. (4) Separation of concerns: LLMProvider Protocol seam enables injecting stub without changing business logic.
